title: My Birthday🎂Celebration🥳
description:
Here is my birthday celebration with the best return gift for my friend! They have been telling me how there skin feels dry and itchy after every shower and thats why I gave them the Fiama Japanese Hokkaido Milk Bar. 

It's made with real Japanese Hokkaido Milk and the lather is unbelievably creamy — it literally melts into the skin instead of tightening it like regular soaps.

It also has Omega-3 and Omega-6 fatty acids that help support the skin barrier and keep skin feeling soft, not stripped.
